title: Manifest
description: GET /capabilities. What the add-on can do; the backend intersects it with its own operation policy. The backend decodes it strictly, so the schema is closed.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 1: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

entitlement_schema.description: The fields of desired state Syndra may fill.

operations.description: The one-shot operations the add-on offers.

lifecycle.description: Resolver-computed; no role-to-target mapping may name it.

label.description: The field's name for a person.

single.description: A person has one value whatever their roles say.

per_person.description: An operator may set this field for one person, over what roles give.

id.description: The operation id, e.g. password.set; a name in registry/operations.json.

scope.description: The broadest scope the add-on offers it at; the backend narrows it to its own ceiling.

secret_params.description: Parameter names whose values are never persisted or logged.

available.description: The target can perform it right now.

Connection.description: How a member reaches the target; absent when the deployment has not said.

protocol.description: What a member connects with, e.g. smb.

host.description: The name a member types, never the API URL.
